title: epipactis purpurata subsp. kuenkeleana
intro: Epipactis purpurata subsp. kuenkeleana, commonly known as the Purple Helleborine, is a subspecies of orchid native to parts of Asia, specifically in China, Japan, and Korea. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its reported health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Epipactis purpurata subsp. kuenkeleana are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
